snippet.title: Leaf it Alone - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Leaf it Alone is a relaxing 2–3 hour leaf-cleaning sim where you need to tidy over 100,000 leaves in one go, upgrade your tools, complete objectives and achievements along the way - and much more! 

📅 Coming this October
👉 Wishlist on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3981100/Leaf_it_Alone/
💬 Join our Discord ➤ https://discord.gg/bHnGJKQeks

Every wishlist or comment means a lot to us. Thanks for checking it out! 🍁
